integrity: Constructive all-size graph classification, explicitly ordered free-triangle collapses, integral Alexander duality, and Hurewicz–Whitehead; finite stress-test program included.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to ordinary four-cut complexes of \(M_{2n}\), integers \(n\ge5\); no equivariant, total-cut or other-parameter classification; computational checks are finite and do not replace the uniform combinatorial proof. Related literature may not be fully indexed.
title: Ordinary four-cut complexes of Möbius ladders form uniform sphere wedges
